options: reset time from the limit message, else a fixed 15 minutes
fields.statement: The Claude adapter recognises the usage limit when the last assistant line of the session's transcript says 'usage limit reached' (the reset as a Unix time after a bar) or 'hit your limit'. While the agent runs, the run reads the transcript every 30 seconds and stops an agent left open at its limit; after the agent ends, a limited session waits until the reset time the message gives, else a fixed 15 minutes, then resumes. One session pauses at most 24 times: still limited after that, the session fails with that reason instead of passing.
fields.wording: the implementing agent's choice, made by the review-cycle-2 fixer to answer the confirmed qa and model findings; not the owner's words
